profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full Stack Developer with 7+ years of experience designing, developing, testing,
and implementing Java and JavaScript-based applications. Strong adaptability
to new technical concepts and a solid understanding of software engineering
principles. Experienced in proposing and executing innovative projects using
Java and its family of tools, including Angular, React, and Python.
